evidence: A valid settlement can release 96 units, quarantine 24, cover 18 battery-affected units with certified 2-hour isolation before remanufacturing, schedule 16 remanufacturing hours in the production schedule, and cite revealed PF1 and PF3. A settlement using generic release or hold numbers without those disclosed facts would fail C1/C2 and P1 or fail C5/C7 and P2.
